description: Maison Aurelle V2 Product Metafield Definitions for Shopify Admin

metafields.name: Curatorial Label
metafields.description: Editorial badge or category indicator (e.g. Flagship Collection, Limited Production Run)

metafields.name: Configuration Note
metafields.description: Short specification line shown in buy box (e.g. Standard Accent — 45cm Ø × 52cm H)

metafields.name: Dimensions & Scale Profile
metafields.description: Detailed dimensional breakdown: form, elevation, mass, balance, and sofa alignment

metafields.name: Materials & Construction
metafields.description: Detailed composition, marble finishing, brass trim, and internal reinforcement

metafields.name: What's Included
metafields.description: Inventory list of items arriving inside the transit package

metafields.name: Assembly Guide
metafields.description: Tool-free instructions and guidance notes for placement

metafields.name: Care & Maintenance
metafields.description: Preservation protocols: daily microfiber wipe, coaster use, paste wax schedule

metafields.name: Shipping & Returns Information
metafields.description: Verified packaging specifications, carrier coverage, and return eligibility

metafields.name: Complementary Companion Products
metafields.description: 1 to 2 curated companion accents displayed in the PDP assemblage pairing section

metafields.name: Moulding Pieces Per Pack
metafields.description: Number of pieces contained in each standard carton

metafields.name: Moulding Coverage
metafields.description: Linear or surface coverage metric (e.g. 9.6 linear meters / pack)
